findings.title: Low-contrast role label on More
findings.observed: The 12px Demo workspace label renders #9eacb9 on white, contrast 2.31:1. Axe reports serious color-contrast on desktop and mobile.
findings.next: Scope the light label color to the navy header; preserve a sufficient text contrast on the white More surface. Re-run both More views.

findings.title: Source Sans 3 is not the rendered font
findings.observed: Both heading and body use the system font stack. The --font-sans computed value is empty, while --font-source-sans exists on body.
findings.next: Resolve the next/font variable and the semantic font token at the same scope. Verify the actual computed heading/body font on production, rather than only checking the font source file.

findings.title: Owner settings has no visible desktop navigation entry
findings.observed: For an authenticated Owner at desktop size, visible navigation contains neither /app/settings nor /app/more. Settings works when its URL is entered directly; mobile reaches it through More.
findings.next: Expose a discoverable Owner settings entry in the desktop shell, without weakening server-side access checks.

findings.title: Responsive overflow in the narrow header and long-SKU adjustment form
findings.observed: At requested/client width 320px, document scroll width is 353px in desktop and touch contexts. At 390px the Manager header truncates workspace identity to H... . The 390px adjustment dialog also lets valid long-SKU form controls extend to x=503.78, beyond its x=390 boundary; drawer-body clientWidth=389 and scrollWidth=503.
findings.next: Rebalance the narrow header while preserving workspace identity, and constrain form grid/select intrinsic widths. Verify both 320px page reflow and valid long SKUs inside the 390px drawer. Compare scrollWidth against clientWidth, not mobile innerWidth alone.

findings.title: Order facts show internal IDs instead of business names
findings.observed: Warehouse and Created by display UUID strings. They provide little operational meaning beside a customer/order record.
findings.next: Return the actual tenant-scoped warehouse name and creator display name. Keep IDs only in an optional technical/copy affordance; do not substitute the current viewer for the actual creator.

findings.title: Successful integration retry does not link to its created order
findings.observed: The live manual retry succeeds and its API response contains orderId, but the succeeded delivery drawer shows metadata/payload without an Open order action.
findings.next: Connect the succeeded delivery to the created order's canonical detail URL and preserve a return path to the delivery.
